description: Mechanics qualification arm of the shared end-to-end lineage on the LFM line (owner 2026-10-12: qualify e2e now so the direct phases can hand off into it on parent_readiness instead of after their full epoch). Starts from Pop's running main LFM direct phase at update 9000 (neuralese-direct-lfm-muon-main-20261012-v2, strict direct export, SHA-verified copy on DGX at runs/pop-lfm-muon-main-v2-export-step9000; Pop binds its own copy with --input-binding direct_artifact=PATH, same sha256). Differences from neuralese-e2e-lfm-v1, all operational for a qualification arm: 200 updates (one evaluation and checkpoint point) instead of one 687-record epoch. It runs the lineage's direct_runtime stage on the exact weights, then e2e; e2e-certificate.json reports V against T, shuffled and zeroed on the paired held readers and the drift guard. Its acceptance is evidence about the stage mechanics, not a qualified artifact of the main lineage. Its parent trained without a QAT curriculum (update 9000 precedes the objective continuation), so the shared q4 point is held at the parent's progress 0 (lambda 0).
